Spacecraft name AAReST MirrorSat 1 (Autonomous Assembly of a Reconfigurable Space Telescope)
Type Nanosatellite
Units or mass 7 kg
Status cancelled
Organization Indian Institute of Space Science and Technology
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country India
Partners California Institute of Technology
Oneliner

Part of the AAReST project for reconfigurable space telescope.
Description

Demonstrate key technologies: – Autonomous assembly and reconfiguration of modular spacecraft carrying mirror segments – Active, lightweight deformable mirrors operating as segments in a primary.
Notes

3U CubeSat plus non-standard and larger optical payload at the end. AAReST CoreSat is not purely a CubeSat nor under 10 kg.
